Team —

Quick reminder ahead of today’s submit window. A few asks for the Acme lane and a couple other late-stage deals so Finance can reconcile forecast today: 

1) Update stage in Salesforce to the correct Commit state if you own the account (example: move ACME-87 to Commit -> Forecast).
2) Upload the attestation packet to the evidence Drive folder (linked below) and add the filename to the evidence_roster_acme.pdf wrapper.
3) Flag any deals that need an executive escalation or documented PO/commit date in the deal notes.

Deadline: please finish updates by 11:00 PT so we can run the forecast rollup at 11:15. We’ll do a short 15-minute pre-call at 11:30 to confirm any blockers and finalize submission. Join here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-commit-precall

Agenda for 11:30 (15m):
- Quick callouts: blocked deals (3 min)
- Evidence roster status: who’s missing files (4 min)
- Final stage flips & notes (4 min)
- Owner signoff / handoff (4 min)

Attachments: forecast_template_q2.xlsx (fill required fields), evidence_roster_acme.pdf (current roster).

Why this matters: Finance is reconciling expected ARR and needs consistent stage tags + evidence to accept Commit signals. If you need help with the Drive upload or doc formatting ping me directly.

Thanks —
Ethan Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Sarah — good questions and appreciated. Quick clarifications: 

- PO vs Commit: We accept the Commit signal on a combination of documented buyer intent + evidence. A formal PO is ideal but not strictly required to set Commit if we have a signed cover letter + clear billing start date documented in the deal notes. Mina has uploaded the cover letter and added the PO placeholder in the deal notes.
- Billing start date: Confirmed as July 1, 2026 per the commercial review. I’ve updated the HubSpot deal and Salesforce notes to reflect July 1 as the billing start.
- SOW: Please loop procurement when the SOW is ready; Mina will attach it to the Drive and we’ll add it to evidence_roster_acme.pdf.

11:30 pre-call: same link — please join if you want to be on-record for the Commit signoff. If procurement prefers to meet separately we can schedule a 10-minute sync right after.

Final note to the reps: if you haven’t uploaded evidence, I’ll ping you at 10:50 PT to avoid last-minute surprises.
